title: Generic Components
description: Learn how to create reusable generic components.
longDescription: Generic components are the bridge between TypeScript's type system and React's component model. In this module, you will build components that work with any data type — lists, forms, polymorphic elements — while maintaining full compile-time type safety. Each pattern you learn eliminates a class of runtime bugs and makes your UI library infinitely reusable. By the end, you will think in generics naturally and apply them to every new component you build.
